title: Serbia
data: 8,270 polling stations of 2026 (Serbia and Kosovo), National Assembly elections 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026 re-expressed on the 2026 stations, each election's lists with at least 1% plus Other (2026: Studentska lista, SNS, SPS, Other)
why: K = 10, against K = 5 (only these two fitted, ten starts each; BIC 1,672,514 and 1,721,155); all K = 5 starts that reach the best fit give the same partition, but only one of ten K = 10 starts reaches the best fit, so the boundaries between neighbouring SNS-leaning K = 10 blocs are provisional; the globe shades the K = 5 blocs (central Serbia, the SNS south and east, the towns, Belgrade and Novi Sad, the minority areas), each municipality taking the bloc of most of its 2026 voters

pca.cap: Rotating principal components of the stations' 39 list shares, 2020–2026, coloured by the K = 10 blocs. PC1 (44%) runs from the opposition (SPN 2023, UZPS 2022, Studentska lista 2026) to SNS; PC2 (26%) separates the Bosniak and Albanian lists; PC3 (11%) is the Hungarian SVM vote. Click for the demographic panels.

demog.cap: Demographics: the same turning PCA in nine panels, coloured by the K = 10 blocs, by municipal measures (2022 census ethnicity, religion, mother tongue, tertiary education and unemployment; 2025 net wages; the 2014 development group) and by the station's own 2026 Studentska lista share. Each station takes its municipality's value; sextiles of stations, dark = high.

map.cap: Bloc map, K = 10: each municipality coloured by the bloc whose stations cast most of its 2026 votes, paler where its stations are spread over more blocs (effective number of blocs); dots are the polling stations in their own bloc's colour, placed at their settlement. Inset: central Belgrade. Blocs numbered by 2026 SNS share, lowest first.

heat.cap: Vote shares in each federal election (columns: party by election), 1,200 sampled polling stations (rows), grouped by bloc. Hover for a row's share; click to pin it.
